newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada opposition bloc urges Canadian debate.
newsitem.headline: Canada opposition bloc urges Canadian debate.

text.p: The Bloc Quebecois, Canada's official opposition party, demanded on Friday an urgent parliamentary debate on the future of Canadian Airlines Corp after the resignation of the board of directors of the company's operating unit.

"Canadian seems to be heading straight toward bankruptcy. The government's direction must be known, in order to avoid turning the entire airline industry upside down," Paul Crete, transport critic for the Bloc, said in a statement. The Bloc, which backs Quebec independence, has said it supports having only one airline in Canada -- Montreal-based Air Canada.
